I submitted the pizza order on httpbin.org/forms/post, and the server's response page shows every field I entered. I left that page open in its tab.

The submitted form data was:
- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon and extra cheese (listed as `bacon` and `cheese`)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** "Ring twice"

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://httpbin.org/forms/post; agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i

B="agent-browser --session task-1965da852b0e"; $B fill @e2 "Ada Lovelace"; $B fill @e3 "555-0100"; $B fill @e4 "ada@example.com"; $B check @e7; $B check @e8; $B check @e9; $B fill @e12 "Ring twice"; $B click @e14; $B type @e14 "0745PM"; $B eval "document.querySelector('input[type=time]').value"
